mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_authorization_subject_set_binding (id, set_object_type, set_object_id, set_relation, set_workspace_id, set_directory_id, role_id, scope_kind, workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{setObjectType}, #{setObjectId}, #{setRelation}, #{setWorkspaceId}, #{setDirectoryId}, #{roleId}, #{scopeKind}, #{workspaceId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, 'ACTIVE', 1, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, set_object_type, set_object_id, set_relation, set_workspace_id, set_directory_id, role_id, scope_kind, workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, version FROM ainer_authorization_subject_set_binding WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_authorization_subject_set_binding SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, revoked_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, set_object_type, set_object_id, set_relation, set_workspace_id, set_directory_id, role_id, scope_kind, workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, version FROM ainer_authorization_subject_set_binding WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= #{at} AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > #{at}) AND ( (scope_kind = 'WORKSPACE' AND workspace_id = #{resource.workspaceId}) OR (scope_kind = 'RESOURCE' AND workspace_id = #{resource.workspaceId} AND resource_type = #{resource.resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resource.resourceId}) ) ORDER BY created_at, id
